title: Custom Forcing: Training-Free Subject Customization for Autoregressive Video Generation
title_zh: Custom Forcing：无需训练的主体自定义方法，用于自回归视频生成

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video models can generate minute-long videos in real time, but they produce generic subjects from text rather than specific subjects from user-provided images. Existing customization methods either require costly per-subject optimization or use pretrained conditioning networks that jointly process all video frames with bidirectional attention. Neither approach is designed for causal streaming. We present Custom Forcing , a training-free method that stores reference-based anchor frames in the persistent KV cache of a frozen autoregressive video model. However, fixed anchors face two limitations: simple conditioning allows identity to drift, and the text prompt continues to favor a generic subject. To address these problems, drift-adaptive value amplification (DVA) scales reference influence with the degree of identity drift, while anchor contrast guidance (ACG) steers generation away from the generic class prior. Over two-minute rollouts, fixed anchors fall from 0.58 0.58 to 0.42 0.42 in DINO-I, while Custom Forcing keeps it between 0.58 0.58 and 0.62 0.62 without reducing motion. Custom Forcing also achieves higher subject similarity than bidirectional customization methods and better preserves identity over 30 30 s than causal image-to-video and reference-to-video models, while generating each frame 9.5 9.5 – 28.5 × 28.5\times faster than these long-video baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归视频模型能够实时生成长达一分钟的视频，但它们会根据文本生成通用主题，而非根据用户提供的图像生成特定主题。 现有的定制化方法要么需要针对每个主题进行高成本的优化，要么使用预训练的调节网络，通过双向注意力机制联合处理所有视频帧。 这两种方法都没有为因果流式处理而设计。 我们提出了“强制定制”（Custom Forcing）——一种无需训练的方法，它将基于参考的锚定帧存储在冻结自回归视频模型的持久 KV 缓存中。 然而，固定锚点存在两个局限性：简单的调节会导致身份特征发生漂移，而文本提示仍会倾向于生成通用主题。 为解决这些问题，漂移自适应值增强（DVA）会根据身份特征漂移的程度调整参考信息的影响，而锚点对比引导（ACG）则会将生成结果从通用类别先验中引导开。 在超过两分钟的连续生成过程中，固定锚点的 DINO-I 分数从 0.58 下降至 0.42，而“强制定制”方法则能将其维持在 0.58 到 0.62 之间，且不会降低动态表现。 “强制定制”方法在主题相似性上也优于双向定制化方法，并且在超过 30 秒的生成过程中比因果图像转视频和参考转视频模型更能保留身份特征，同时生成每帧的速度比这些长视频基线模型快 9.5 – 28.5 倍。

paragraphs.en: Video generation models can now turn a text prompt or an input image into a high-quality video, and they are increasingly used for world models, robotics, and content creation ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Pondaven et al., 2026 ) . Bidirectional video generation models ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) denoise all frames jointly at every sampling step, so every step processes the entire video and generation is slow. Autoregressive video models instead generate frames or chunks in temporal order and condition each step on previous outputs ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Teng et al., 2025 ) . With distillation or adversarial post-training, they need only a few denoising steps per chunk and can stream video in real time ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , and rolling contexts bound their memory as the video grows ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . These properties support real-time and long-horizon applications such as interactive video generation and world models ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Pondaven et al., 2026 ) . In such applications, users often want a specific subject, such as their own pet or toy, to appear throughout the video. Given only a text prompt, however, a conventional autoregressive video model generates a generic instance of the category.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成模型现在能够将文本提示或输入图像转化为高质量视频，并且越来越多地用于世界模型、机器人技术和内容创作（Brooks 等，2024；Wan 等，2025；Xu 等，2026b；Yang 等，2026b；Pondaven 等，2026）。 双向视频生成模型（Brooks 等，2024；Wan 等，2025）在每次采样步骤中联合去除所有帧的噪声，因此每一步都会处理整个视频，导致生成过程缓慢。 相反，自回归视频模型按时间顺序生成帧或片段，并在每一步以先前输出为条件（Chen 等，2024；Teng 等，2025）。 通过蒸馏或对抗性后训练，这些模型每个片段只需少量去噪步骤，即可实时流式传输视频（Yin 等，2025；Huang 等，2026；Lin 等，2026），而滚动上下文机制会随着视频增长限制其内存（Liu 等，2026b；Yang 等，2025；Cui 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026）。 这些特性支持实时和长时域应用，例如交互式视频生成和世界模型（Yang 等，2025；Xu 等，2026b；Yang 等，2026b；Pondaven 等，2026）。 在此类应用中，用户通常希望某个特定主体（例如自己的宠物或玩具）贯穿整个视频。 然而，如果仅给定文本提示，传统的自回归视频模型会生成该类别的一个通用实例。

paragraphs.en: Image customization methods either optimize the model for each subject ( Gal et al., 2022 ; Ruiz et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ) or use pretrained subject encoders or adapters that generalize to unseen subjects ( Wei et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . Video customization follows the same two approaches ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2026 ) , but optimizing a video model for each subject is costly, and training with still images makes it difficult to preserve motion ( Chefer et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . These methods also denoise the frames of a bounded video jointly, which a causal generator cannot do: its finalized frames cannot be revised, and the reference must remain available throughout an open-ended rollout. A simpler alternative gives an image of the subject to an image-to-video model as its first frame. As Sec. 4.2 shows, however, causal image-to-video models lose the subject within 30 30 s, and a bidirectional one cannot generate long videos.
paragraphs.zh: 图像定制方法要么为每个主体优化模型（Gal et al., 2022；Ruiz et al., 2023；Kumari et al., 2023），要么使用预训练的主体编码器或适配器，使其能够泛化到未见的主体（Wei et al., 2023；Ye et al., 2023；Li et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2024）。 视频定制也遵循相同的两种方法（Ma et al., 2024；Wei et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2025；Jiang et al., 2024；Yuan et al., 2025；Xue et al., 2026），但为每个主体优化视频模型成本高昂，而使用静态图像进行训练则难以保留动态效果（Chefer et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2025）。 这些方法还会联合去除有界视频中各帧的噪声，而这正是因果生成器无法做到的：其最终生成的帧无法修改，且参考信息必须在整个开放式的生成过程中持续可用。 一种更简单的替代方案是，将主体的图像作为第一帧输入到图像到视频模型中。 然而，正如第 4.2 节所示，因果图像到视频模型会在 30 秒内丢失主体，而双向模型则无法生成长视频。

paragraphs.en: In streaming generation, once a chunk is finalized, appearance errors propagate through subsequent chunks and cause progressive divergence from the external subject reference. We call this identity drift . Existing long-video methods maintain consistency with generated history using attention sinks ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ; Yi et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ) , persistent memory ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Yesiltepe et al., 2026 ; Dalva and Yanardag, 2026 ) , or longer contexts ( Cui et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Mao et al., 2026 ) . However, consistency with generated history does not ensure fidelity to the user-provided subject. We store the user’s reference images and a scene-specific custom anchor as persistent anchor frames in the KV cache, making them available to every generated chunk without fine-tuning or an additional conditioning network. These anchors establish the subject initially but cannot prevent identity drift: as shown by the red curve in Fig. 2 , identity similarity steadily declines over a two-minute rollout. Weak anchor influence loses subject-specific details, and strong influence suppresses motion. The text prompt also biases generation toward a generic instance of the subject category.
paragraphs.zh: 在流式生成中，一旦某个片段最终确定，外观错误就会通过后续片段传播，并导致与外部主体参考逐渐偏离。 我们将此现象称为身份漂移。 现有的长视频方法通过注意力汇（Liu et al., 2026b; Li et al., 2026b; Yi et al., 2025; Ye et al., 2026; Zhao et al., 2026b）、持久化内存（Yang et al., 2026a; Kim et al., 2026; Yesiltepe et al., 2026; Dalva and Yanardag, 2026）或更长的上下文（Cui et al., 2026; Yang et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2026b; Mao et al., 2026）来维持与生成历史的一致性。 然而，与生成历史的一致性并不能确保对用户提供的主体的忠实度。 我们将用户的参考图像和场景特定的自定义锚点作为持久化锚点帧存储在 KV 缓存中，使每个生成的片段都能直接使用这些锚点，而无需微调或额外的条件网络。 这些锚点虽然最初确立了主体特征，但无法防止身份漂移：如图 2 中的红色曲线所示，在持续两分钟的生成过程中，身份相似度会稳步下降。 锚点影响较弱时，会丢失主体特有的细节；而影响较强时，则会抑制运动表现。 文本提示也会使生成结果偏向于该主体类别的一个通用实例。

paragraphs.en: We present Custom Forcing , which addresses these limitations by modifying only the backbone’s self-attention. Drift-adaptive value amplification (DVA) scales reference influence with the measured drift of each finalized chunk. Anchor contrast guidance (ACG) contrasts attention outputs computed with and without the anchor frames and extrapolates along their difference, counteracting the generic class prior induced by the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“定制强制”（Custom Forcing）方法，它仅通过修改主干网络的自注意力机制来解决这些局限性。 “漂移自适应值增强”（DVA）会根据每个最终分块的测量漂移来调整参考影响。 “锚点对比引导”（ACG）会对比使用和不使用锚点帧计算出的注意力输出，并沿着它们的差异进行外推，从而抵消提示所引入的通用类别先验。

sents.en: We present Custom Forcing , which addresses these limitations by modifying only the backbone’s self-attention.

paragraphs.en: We present Custom Forcing, a training-free method that customizes a frozen autoregressive video model by keeping the reference images and a custom anchor in its KV cache as anchor frames, without fine-tuning or an additional conditioning network.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“自定义强制”（Custom Forcing）方法，这是一种无需训练的方法，它通过将参考图像和一个自定义锚点保留在冻结的自回归视频模型的 KV 缓存中作为锚帧，从而对模型进行定制，而无需微调或额外的条件网络。

paragraphs.en: We introduce DVA and ACG, two self-attention operations that keep the subject over long rollouts. DVA scales the reference influence with the measured drift of finalized chunks, and ACG extrapolates away from the attention output computed without the anchors to counter the generic class prior.

paragraphs.en: Existing video customization methods introduce a subject through per-subject optimization or an additional conditioning network (see Appendix A ). A autoregressive video model may need neither, because every chunk already reads the KV cache and part of the cache persists for the entire rollout. We hypothesize that images of the subject written into this persistent part can serve as its reference throughout generation if the model reads them with the right strength and in the right direction.

paragraphs.en: Before the first chunk is generated, we encode N N images of the subject with the VAE, one latent frame per image, and pass them through G θ G_{\theta} as clean frames, which writes their keys and values into the cache of every block. We call these frames the custom K/V and index them by 𝒜 = { 1 , … , N } \mathcal{A}=\{1,\dots,N\} . The custom K/V occupies the attention sink of Sec. 2.1 in place of the first generated frames. It precedes all generated frames and is never evicted, so every chunk reads it through the ordinary attention of Eq. ( 3 ), without a retrieval step or an additional conditioning branch.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成第一个分块之前，我们使用 VAE 对主体的 N 张图像进行编码，每张图像对应一个潜在帧，并将这些潜在帧作为干净帧输入 G θ G_{\theta}，由其将键值写入每个分块的缓存中。我们将这些帧称为自定义 K/V，并以 𝒜 = { 1 , … , N } \mathcal{A}=\{1,\dots,N\} 进行索引。自定义 K/V 会取代第 2.1 节中注意力机制的接收端，位于所有已生成帧之前且永远不会被驱逐。因此，每个分块都通过公式 (3) 中的常规注意力机制直接读取它，无需检索步骤或额外的条件分支。

paragraphs.en: ACG therefore multiplies the attention share that each query already places on the anchor frames, while the clip bounds the norm of z ext z_{\text{ext}} . Unlike RefDrop ( Fan et al., 2024 ) , which replaces this query-dependent share with a constant, ACG scales it, so queries that already read the subject from the anchors read it more strongly. Unlike NAG ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , which contrasts a positive and a negative prompt in cross-attention, ACG obtains its negative branch by masking the anchor frames in self-attention. Neither branch requires an additional forward pass of the network (Appendix A.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 因此，ACG 会放大每个查询对锚定帧已有的注意力分配比例，同时 clip 会限制 z ext z_{\text{ext}} 的范数。 与 RefDrop（Fan et al., 2024）不同，后者用常数替代了这种依赖查询的注意力分配比例，而 ACG 则对其进行缩放，使得那些已从锚定帧中读取到主体的查询能够更强烈地读取该主体。 与 NAG（Chen et al., 2026a）不同，后者在交叉注意力中对正向提示和负向提示进行对比，而 ACG 则是通过在自注意力中掩码锚定帧来获得其负向分支。 两个分支都不需要网络执行额外的前向传播（附录 A.3）。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose Custom Forcing , a training-free method that customizes autoregressive video generation with images of a user-provided subject through the KV cache. It needs neither per-subject optimization nor an additional conditioning network, only five reference images and one generated image of the subject in the scene, and it adds 11 11 – 13 % 13\% to the generation time of fixed anchors. The custom K/V, written into the cache once, establishes the identity from the first chunk. DVA reads the reference images more strongly the further the subject drifts, and ACG extrapolates away from the attention output computed without the anchor frames, steering generation away from the generic subject favored by the prompt. Without modifying the backbone, Custom Forcing keeps the subject close to the reference images for two minutes without reducing motion, holding DINO-I between 0.58 0.58 and 0.62 0.62 while fixed anchors fall to 0.42 0.42 . Because it changes only what the KV cache holds and how it is read, it also applies to Deep Forcing, another autoregressive model with an attention sink (Appendix D.2 ). Appendix G discusses its limitations. A direction for future work is to keep a user’s subject in interactive world models, which also generate video causally over long horizons.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 Custom Forcing——一种无需训练的方法，它通过 KV 缓存利用用户提供的主体图像来定制自回归视频生成。 该方法既不需要针对每个主体进行优化，也不需要额外的条件网络，仅需五张参考图像和一张场景中该主体的生成图像，且会使固定锚点的生成时间增加 11%–13%。 自定义的 K/V 只需写入缓存一次，即可从第一个片段开始确立主体的身份特征。 DVA 会随着主体偏离参考图像的程度增加而更强烈地读取这些参考图像，而 ACG 则会脱离未包含锚点帧的计算出的注意力输出进行外推，从而引导生成过程远离提示词所偏好的通用主体。 在不修改主干网络的前提下，Custom Forcing 能够在两分钟内使主体保持与参考图像高度一致，同时不降低动态性：DINO-I 值维持在 0.58 至 0.62 之间，而固定锚点的 DINO-I 则降至 0.42。 由于该方法仅改变 KV 缓存的内容及其读取方式，因此也适用于 Deep Forcing——另一种带有注意力汇口的自回归模型（附录 D.2）。 附录 G 讨论了该方法的局限性。 未来的一个研究方向是在交互式世界模型中保留用户的主体，这类模型也能在长时间跨度内以因果方式生成视频。

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional video generation models ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) generate fixed-length videos by denoising the sequence jointly. Autoregressive alternatives produce frames or chunks causally, making it possible to stream outputs and extend generation beyond a fixed video length. Diffusion Forcing introduced per-frame noise levels for causal sequence generation ( Chen et al., 2024 ) ; CausVid and Self Forcing distilled or post-trained causal few-step generators from pretrained video diffusion models ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) ; and MAGI-1 scaled chunk-wise autoregressive generation to long contexts ( Teng et al., 2025 ) . Later work improves distillation and rollout training ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026b ; Guo et al., 2026 ) , reduces attention and KV-cache cost ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Lv et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ; Ji et al., 2026 ) , or trains causal world models for interactive control ( Xu et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Pondaven et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 双向视频生成模型（Brooks 等，2024；Wan 等，2025）通过联合去噪序列来生成固定长度的视频。 自回归替代方法以因果方式生成帧或片段，从而可以流式传输输出，并将生成过程扩展到固定视频长度之外。 Diffusion Forcing 为因果序列生成引入了每帧噪声水平（Chen 等，2024）；CausVid 和 Self Forcing 从预训练的视频扩散模型中蒸馏或后训练了因果少步生成器（Yin 等，2025；Huang 等，2026）；而 MAGI-1 则将基于片段的自回归生成扩展到了长上下文（Teng 等，2025）。 后续研究改进了蒸馏和展开训练（Lin 等，2026；Zhu 等，2026a；Zhao 等，2026a；Lu 等，2026；Zhu 等，2026b；Guo 等，2026），降低了注意力和 KV 缓存成本（Zhang 等，2026；Lv 等，2026；Xu 等，2026a；Ji 等，2026），或训练了用于交互式控制的因果世界模型（Xu 等，2026b；Yang 等，2026b；Pondaven 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Long rollouts accumulate errors beyond the training horizon. Recent methods preserve selected parts of the generated history through rolling attention sinks ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ; Yi et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ) , positional re-indexing, anchor tokens, and evolving memory states ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Yesiltepe et al., 2026 ; Dalva and Yanardag, 2026 ) , longer context windows ( Cui et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Mao et al., 2026 ) , or explicit spatial memory ( Huang et al., 2025a ) . These methods improve consistency with generated context. Custom Forcing instead maintains fidelity to user-provided reference images that are external to the rollout.

paragraphs.en: Subject customization has been extensively studied for images. Textual Inversion, DreamBooth, and Custom Diffusion optimize embeddings or model parameters for each subject ( Gal et al., 2022 ; Ruiz et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ) , while ELITE, IP-Adapter, PhotoMaker, and InstantID learn reusable encoders or adapters for zero-shot conditioning ( Wei et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . These approaches establish the two main strategies used by later video methods: subject-specific optimization and pretrained reference conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 针对图像的主体定制方法已被广泛研究。 文本反转、DreamBooth 和 Custom Diffusion 会针对每个主体优化嵌入或模型参数（Gal 等，2022；Ruiz 等，2023；Kumari 等，2023），而 ELITE、IP-Adapter、PhotoMaker 和 InstantID 则会学习可重复使用的编码器或适配器，以实现零样本条件生成（Wei 等，2023；Ye 等，2023；Li 等，2024；Wang 等，2024）。 这些方法确立了后续视频方法所采用的两种主要策略：主体特定优化和预训练参考条件生成。

paragraphs.en: Video customization methods based on subject-specific optimization include Magic-Me, DreamVideo, and CustomCrafter ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . CustomVideo instead combines attention control with subject masks for multi-subject customization ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Still-Moving transfers an image-customized model to video without requiring customized video data ( Chefer et al., 2024 ) . A second group uses pretrained or reusable video-conditioning systems for zero-shot or feed-forward customization, including VideoBooth, ID-Animator, ConsisID, VideoMaker, SUGAR, MagicMirror, and Stand-In ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024b ; Zhou et al., 2024a ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2026 ) . Recent systems extend this setting to multiple subjects, broader control signals, or unified creation interfaces ( Huang et al., 2025b ; Liang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Fei et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) . These methods primarily target bidirectional video generation and typically denoise a bounded video jointly. They generally do not address open-ended causal rollouts, where completed frames cannot be revised and reference information must remain available throughout generation.

paragraphs.en: Classifier-free guidance combines conditional and unconditional model predictions at inference time ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) . Normalized Attention Guidance (NAG) instead extrapolates between the attention outputs for a positive and a negative prompt and normalizes the result, which keeps negative guidance stable in few-step sampling ( Chen et al., 2026a ) . Prompt-to-Prompt and MasaCtrl manipulate cross-attention or self-attention to control image editing and consistent synthesis ( Hertz et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2023 ) . For consistent subjects without training, ConsiStory and StoryDiffusion share self-attention across the images of a batch ( Tewel et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024b ) , and RefDrop shows that such sharing interpolates self-attention and reference attention, replacing the interpolation weight with a user-set constant ( Fan et al., 2024 ) . Custom Forcing builds on these ideas for a causal stream. ACG adopts the normalization of NAG but derives its negative branch by masking reference frames in the cache rather than from a negative prompt, and, unlike RefDrop, it scales the attention share that each query already places on the references instead of mixing in a constant amount, so queries that place little attention on the references remain nearly unchanged. Unlike classifier-free guidance, neither branch of ACG requires an additional forward pass, only a second attention read in each block. DVA further adjusts the reference values during sampling from an online measurement of subject similarity.
paragraphs.zh: 无分类器引导在推理阶段结合了条件模型和无条件模型的预测（Ho 和 Salimans，2022）。 归一化注意力引导（NAG）则是在正向提示和负向提示的注意力输出之间进行外推并对结果进行归一化，从而在少步采样中保持负向引导的稳定性（Chen 等，2026a）。 Prompt-to-Prompt 和 MasaCtrl 通过操控交叉注意力或自注意力来控制图像编辑和一致性合成（Hertz 等，2022；Cao 等，2023）。 对于无需训练的具有一致主体的场景，ConsiStory 和 StoryDiffusion 在批处理中的各图像间共享自注意力（Tewel 等，2024；Zhou 等，2024b），而 RefDrop 表明这种共享方式可以在自注意力和参考注意力之间进行插值，并将插值权重替换为用户设定的常数（Fan 等，2024）。 自定义强制方法基于这些思想构建了一个因果流。 ACG 采用了 NAG 的归一化方法，但其负向分支是通过掩码缓存中的参考帧而非负向提示生成的；与 RefDrop 不同，它调整的是每个查询对参考项已有的注意力共享比例，而不是混入一个固定的数值量，因此那些对参考项注意力较弱的查询几乎保持不变。 与无分类器引导不同，ACG 的两个分支都不需要额外的前向传播，只需在每个块中执行第二次注意力读取即可。 DVA 进一步在采样过程中根据主体相似性的在线测量结果调整参考值。

paragraphs.en: Vanilla AR + LoRA fine-tunes Rolling Forcing itself. Following DreamBooth ( Ruiz et al., 2023 ) , we add a new token <sks> to the text encoder and train it together with LoRA adapters of rank 16 16 ( α = 16 \alpha=16 ) on the query, key, value, and output projections of the self- and cross-attention layers. Each reference image is repeated into a static clip of 9 9 frames ( 3 3 latent frames) and flipped horizontally with probability 0.5 0.5 . The loss is the mean squared error of the predicted clean latent at one of the five denoising steps of the distilled generator, sampled uniformly and computed through the KV cache, plus a prior-preservation loss with weight 1 1 on three clips from each class video of the vanilla AR model. We train for 1,000 1{,}000 steps with AdamW, using a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} and weight decay 0.01 0.01 for the LoRA weights and a learning rate of 10 − 2 10^{-2} without weight decay for the token embedding, with 20 20 warm-up steps, cosine decay, and gradient clipping at 1 1 . Training takes about 12 12 minutes per subject. At inference, the LoRA scale is 0.5 0.5 .

paragraphs.en: All of them also receive the video prompt. FramePack and FramePack-F1 use their released checkpoints, which are built on HunyuanVideo, with 25 25 sampling steps, distilled guidance 10 10 , and TeaCache disabled, and generate 832 × 480 832\times 480 video at 30 30 fps. SkyReels-V2 DF uses the 1.3B 540P checkpoint in synchronous mode with 30 30 sampling steps and guidance scale 6 6 , and generates 960 × 544 960\times 544 video at 24 24 fps. FramePack-F1 is the forward-only variant of FramePack. SkyReels-V3 uses the R2V-14B checkpoint with the first four reference images, its maximum, and its official sampling settings, and generates 5 5 s of 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 video at 24 24 fps, which its official single-shot extension (V2V-14B) continues to 32.7 32.7 s. Its pipeline sets the output shape from the aspect ratio of the first reference image, so we pad that image to 16 : 9 16{:}9 with the pipeline’s own resizing. Custom Forcing receives the same custom anchor and all five reference images. We cut every output to the length of our videos. paragraphs.en: Custom Forcing controls identity for the subject as a whole, not for its parts. The drift signal s ⁡ ( t ) s(t) compares the whole subject with the reference images, and DVA sets the amplification of every subject token of the reference anchors from this single signal. A change confined to one small part, such as a wheel of the RC car or a strap of the backpack, may therefore change s ⁡ ( t ) s(t) little, and Custom Forcing cannot target that part on its own. The fidelity of Custom Forcing is also bounded by the frozen backbone. Custom Forcing changes only how the backbone attends to the anchors, so appearance that the backbone cannot render remains out of reach. Finally, we evaluate one subject per video for up to two minutes. Multiple subjects and longer horizons remain for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 自定义强制控制的是主体整体的身份，而非其各个部分。 漂移信号 s(t) 将整个主体与参考图像进行比较，而 DVA 则根据这一单一信号设置参考锚点中每个主体标记的放大系数。 因此，局限于某个小部分的改变（例如遥控车的车轮或背包的背带），可能只会对 s(t) 产生微小影响，自定义强制无法单独针对该部分进行调整。 自定义强制的保真度也受到冻结主干网络的限制。 自定义强制仅改变主干网络关注锚点的方式，因此主干网络无法呈现的外观特征仍然无法实现。 最后，我们对每个视频中的单个主体进行最多两分钟的评估。 多个主体和更长的时间范围留待未来研究。

sents.zh: 因此，局限于某个小部分的改变（例如遥控车的车轮或背包的背带），可能只会对 s(t) 产生微小影响，自定义强制无法单独针对该部分进行调整。

sents.en: The fidelity of Custom Forcing is also bounded by the frozen backbone.
sents.zh: 自定义强制的保真度也受到冻结主干网络的限制。

sents.en: Custom Forcing changes only how the backbone attends to the anchors, so appearance that the backbone cannot render remains out of reach.
sents.zh: 自定义强制仅改变主干网络关注锚点的方式，因此主干网络无法呈现的外观特征仍然无法实现。

sents.en: Finally, we evaluate one subject per video for up to two minutes.
sents.zh: 最后，我们对每个视频中的单个主体进行最多两分钟的评估。

sents.en: Multiple subjects and longer horizons remain for future work.
sents.zh: 多个主体和更长的时间范围留待未来研究。
